answer: Draw the jury from distinct subnets. Record the draw alongside the claim. Replay the signed body against every prior submission. A panel that shares a subnet is void, one upheld challenge revokes the key, and a replay match voids every key that carried the same text. On 12 October, 44 keys submitted one lotus-themed body; the replay matched all 44 and the bonds were revoked in the same epoch. Basalt under the bridge, not the span, is what carried the load.
